package.name: benchmark_logging
package.description: Field-trial data-collection instrumentation for school_traffic_control: trial start/stop management, a JSON-over-String event/status bus, and a JSONL logger for state-machine events, detections, plate reads, drone link status, and robot pose — scoped to explicit operator-started trials, not one continuous log. Also manages a throttled-camera rosbag2 recording per trial. No new behavior for the robot itself — purely instrumentation for a research evaluation.
